`split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n317\t/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n318\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n319\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n320\t/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n321\t/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n322\t/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n323\t///\n324\t/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n325\t/// statement terminators.\n326\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n327\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n328\t    let len = bytes.len();\n329\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n330\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n331\t    let mut i = 0;\n332\t\n333\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n334\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n335\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n336\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n337\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n338\t\n339\t    while i < len {\n340\t        let b = bytes[i];\n341\t\n342\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n343\t        if in_line_comment {\n344\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n345\t                in_line_comment = false;\n346\t            }\n347\t            i += 1;\n348\t            continue;\n349\t        }\n350\t\n351\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n352\t        if in_block_comment {\n353\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n354\t                in_block_comment = false;\n355\t                i += 2;\n356\t            } else {\n357\t                i += 1;\n358\t            }\n359\t            continue;\n360\t        }\n361\t\n362\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n363\t        if in_single_quote {\n364\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n365\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n366\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n367\t                    i += 2;\n368\t                } else {\n369\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n370\t                    i += 1;\n371\t                }\n372\t            } else {\n373\t                i += 1;\n374\t            }\n375\t            continue;\n376\t        }\n377\t\n378\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n379\t        if in_double_quote {\n380\t            if b == b'\"' {\n381\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n382\t                    i += 2;\n383\t                } else {\n384\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n385\t                    i += 1;\n386\t                }\n387\t            } else {\n388\t                i += 1;\n389\t            }\n390\t            continue;\n391\t        }\n392\t\n393\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n394\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n395\t            in_single_quote = true;\n396\t            i += 1;\n397\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n398\t            in_double_quote = true;\n399\t            i += 1;\n400\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n401\t            in_line_comment = true;\n402\t            i += 2;\n403\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n404\t            in_block_comment = true;\n405\t            i += 2;\n406\t        } else if b == b';' {\n407\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n408\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n409\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n410\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n411\t            }\n412\t            start = i + 1;\n413\t            i += 1;\n414\t        } else {\n415\t            i += 1;\n416\t        }\n417\t    }\n418\t\n419\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n420\t    if start < len {\n421\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n422\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n423\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n424\t        }\n425\t    }\n426\t\n427\t    stmts\n428\t}\n429\t\n430\t/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\n431\tfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n432\t    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n433\t    Ok(())\n434\t}\n435\t\n436\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n437\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n438\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n439\t    Ok(())\n440\t}\n441\t\n442\t/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n443\t/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\n444\tfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> string literals,\n/// quoted identifiers, and comments.\n///\n/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n///\n/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n/// statement terminators.\nfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n    let len = bytes.len();\n    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n    let mut i = 0;\n\n    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\nfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n    let has_es: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE name='es'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_es {\n        // Table has old schema - recreate with new schema\n        conn.execute_batch(\n            \"BEGIN;\n             CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS critical_path_cache_new (\n                 bead_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                 epic_id     TEXT,\n                 es          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 ls          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 float       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 updated_at  DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                 FOREIGN KEY (bead_id) REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n             );\n             INSERT INTO critical_path_cache_new (bead_id, float, updated_at)\n                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n             COMMIT;\",\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_float ON critical_path_cache(float);\",\n    );\n\n    // Migration 2: Add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing\n    // Older databases may not have this column;     \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN workspace_path TEXT\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Migration 3: Add closed_at and duration_seconds to worker_sessions for velocity pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='session_id'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_session_id {\n        conn.execute(\n            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN session_id TEXT\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n        // Generate session_id for existing rows\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE worker_sessions SET session_id = lower(hex(randomblob(16))) WHERE session_id IS NULL\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n        // Create unique index on session_id\n        conn.execute(\n            \"CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_worker_sessions_session_id ON worker_sessions(session_id)\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n    }\n\n prefix: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let    title,\n        status: status.map(|s| Status::from_str(&s).ok()).flatten(),\n        priority,\n        assignee,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidate)?);\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage\n                            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: The WHERE status = 'open' condition ensures we only claim if still open\n354\t            let rows_affected = tx.execute(\n355\t                \"UPDATE issues\n356\t                 SET status = 'in_progress', assignee = ?, updated_at = ?\n357\t                 WHERE id = ? AND status = 'open'\",\n358\t                params![worker, now.to_rfc3339(), &bead_id],\n359\t            )?;\n360\t\n361\t            // If no rows were affected, another worker claimed this bead first\n362\t            if rows_affected == 0 {\n363\t                return Ok(None);\n364\t            }\n365\t\n366\t            // Step 4: Record worker session if metadata provided\n367\t            let session_id = if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n368\t                let session_id = generate_session_id();\n369\t                tx.execute(\n370\t                    \"INSERT INTO worker_sessions (worker_id, model, harness, harness_version, bead_id, workspace_path, session_id)\n371\t                     VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7)\",\n372\t                    params![\n373\t                        &meta.worker_id,\n374\t                        meta.model.as_deref(),\n375\t                        meta.harness.as_deref(),\n376\t                        meta.harness_version.as_deref(),\n377\t                        &bead_id,\n378\t                        \"\", // workspace_path not available in transaction context\n379\t                        &session_id,\n380\t                    ],\n381\t                )?;\n382\t                Some(session_id)\n383\t            } else {\n384\t                None\n385\t            };\n386\t\n387\t            // Step 5: Insert event with worker metadata in comment field\n388\t            let metadata_json = worker_metadata.and_then(|m| serde_json::to_string(m).ok());\n389\t            tx.execute(\n390\t                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, new_value, comment, created_at)\n391\t                 VALUES (?, 'claimed', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n392\t                params![&bead_id, worker, worker, metadata_json, now.to_rfc3339()],\n393\t            )?;\n394\t\n395\t            // Step 6: Mark as dirty\n396\t            tx.execute(\n397\t                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at)\n398\t                 VALUES (?, ?)\",\n399\t                params![&bead_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n400\t            )?;\n401\t\n402\t            Ok(Some(ClaimResult {\n403\t                bead_id,\n404\t                reclaimed,\n405\t                workspace_path: None,\n406\t                session_id,\n407\t            }))\n408\t        } else {\n409\t            Ok(None)\n410\t        }\n411\t    }\n412\t}\n413\t\n414\t/// Get ready candidates using the same scoring logic as claim().\n415\t///\n416\t/// This returns a list of beads that would be considered for claiming,\n417\t/// ordered by the same scoring formula:\n418\t/// - velocity_adjusted_score DESC (impact per unit time, when velocity data available)\n419\t/// - downstream_impact DESC (more blocking = higher priority)\n420\t/// - critical_path_bonus DESC (1000.0/(float+1), higher bonus = more critical)\n421\t/// - priority ASC (0=Critical, 4=Backlog)\n422\t/// - created_at ASC (FIFO tiebreaker)\n423\t///\n424\t/// # Arguments\n425\t/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n426\t/// * `limit` - Maximum number of candidates to return\n427\t/// * `model` - Optional model name for velocity-aware scoring\n428\t/// * `harness` - Optional harness name for velocity-aware scoring\n429\t///\n430\t/// # Returns\n431\t/// * `Ok(Vec<ScoredBead>)` - List of scored bead candidates\n432\tpub fn get_ready_candidates(\n433\t    tx: &Connection,\n434\t    limit: usize,\n435\t    model: Option<&str>,\n436\t    harness: Option<&str>,\n437\t) -> Result<Vec<ScoredBead>> {\n438\t    let mut stmt = if let (Some(_m), Some(_h)) = (model, harness) {\n439\t        // Velocity-aware scoring: divide combined score by expected seconds\n440\t        tx.prepare(\n441\t            \"SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.priority,\n442\t                    COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n443\t                    1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n444\t                    i.created_at,\n445\t                    vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds\n446\t             FROM issues i\n447\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n448\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n449\t             LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n450\t                 AND vs.model = ?1\n451\t                 AND vs.harness = ?2\n452\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n453\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n454\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n455\t               AND i.is_template = 0\n456\t               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n457\t               AND NOT EXISTS (\n458\t                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n459\t                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n460\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n461\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n462\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n463\t               )\n464\t             GROUP BY i.id\n465\t             ORDER BY (\n466\t                 COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n467\t                 + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n468\t                 + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)\n469\t             ) / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n470\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n471\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n472\t                 i.priority ASC,\n473\t                 i.created_at ASC\n474\t             LIMIT ?3\",\n475\t        )?\n476\t    } else {\n477\t        // Standard scoring without velocity data\n478\t        tx.prepare(\n479\t            \"SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.priority,\n480\t                    COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n481\t                    1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n482\t                    i.created_at\n483\t             FROM issues i\n484\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n485\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n486\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n487\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n488\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n489\t               AND i.is_template = 0\n490\t               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n491\t               AND NOT EXISTS (\n492\t                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n493\t                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n494\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n495\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n496\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n497\t               )\n498\t             GROUP BY i.id\n499\t             ORDER BY\n500\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n501\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n502\t                 i.priority ASC,\n503\t                 i.created_at ASC\n504\t             LIMIT ?1\",\n505\t        )?\n506\t    };\n507\t\n508\t    let mut rows = if model.is_some() && harness.is_some() {\n509\t        stmt.query(params![model.unwrap(), harness.unwrap(), limit as i64])?\n510\t    } else {\n511\t        stmt.query(params![limit as i64])?\n512\t    };\n513\t\n514\t    let mut candidates = Vec::new();\n515\t\n516\t    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n517\t        candidates.push(ScoredBead {\n518\t            id: row.get(0)?,\n519\t            title: row.get(1)?,\n520\t            status: row.get(2)?,\n521\t            priority: row.get(3)?,\n522\t            downstream_impact: row.get(4)?,\n523\t            critical_float: row.get(5)?,\n524\t            created_at: row.get(6)?,\n525\t        });\n526\t    }\n527\t\n528\t    Ok(candidates)\n529\t}\n530\t\n531\t/// Claim from the highest-priority bead across multiple workspaces.\n532\t///\n533\t/// Scores each workspace's top candidate, picks the global winner,\n534\t/// and claims from that workspace.\n535\t///\n536\t/// # Arguments\n537\t/// * `workspace_paths` - Slice of workspace directory paths\n538\t/// * `worker` - The worker ID claiming the bead\n539\t/// * `claim_ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes after which in_progress beads are reclaimed\n540\t/// * `worker_metadata` - Optional worker metadata (model, harness, version)\n541\t///\n542\t/// # Returns\n543\t/// * `Ok(Some(claim_result))` - A bead was claimed (with workspace_path set)\n544\t/// * `Ok(None)` - No beads available to claim in any workspace\n545\t/// * `Err(e)` - Transaction error\n546\tpub fn claim_any(\n547\t    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n548\t    worker: &str,\n549\t    claim_ttl_minutes: i64,\n550\t    worker_metadata: Option<&WorkerMetadata>,\n551\t) -> Result<Option<ClaimResult>> {\n552\t    use crate::config::load_metadata;\n553\t    use crate::storage::Storage;\n554\t\n555\t    // Extract model and harness for velocity-aware scoring\n556\t    let (model, harness) = if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n557\t        (meta.model.as_deref(), meta.harness.as_deref())\n558\t    } else {\n559\t        (None, None)\n560\t    };\n561\t\n562\t    // Score across all workspaces\n563\t    let mut best: Option<(Score, usize)> = None;\n564\t    for (idx, workspace_path) in workspace_paths.iter().enumerate() {\n565\t        let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n566\t        let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n567\t        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n568\t\n569\t        // Open each workspace's SQLite\n570\t        match Storage::open(&db_path) {\n571\t            Ok(storage) => {\n572\t                if let Some(score) = storage.top_candidate_score(model, harness)? {\n573\t                    if best.as_ref().map(|(b, _)| score > *b).unwrap_or(true) {\n574\t                        best = Some((score, idx));\n575\t                    }\n576\t                }\n577\t            }\n578\t            Err(_) => {\n579\t                // Skip workspaces that can't be opened (e.g., no .beads directory)\n580\t                continue;\n581\t            }\n582\t        }\n583\t    }\n584\t\n585\t    match best {\n586\t        None => Ok(None),\n587\t        Some((_, workspace_idx)) => {\n588\t            let workspace_path = &workspace_paths[workspace_idx];\n589\t            let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n590\t            let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n591\t            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n592\t            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n593\t\n594\t            let now = Utc::now();\n595\t            match storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n596\t                claim(tx, worker, claim_ttl_minutes, now, worker_metadata)\n597\t            })? {\n598\t                Some(mut result) => {\n599\t                    result.workspace_path = Some(workspace_path.clone());\n600\t                    Ok(Some(result))\n601\t                }\n602\t                None => Ok(None),\n603\t            }\n604\t        }\n605\t    }\n606\t}\n607\t\n608\t/// Get the .beads directory from a workspace path.\n609\t///\n610\t/// If the workspace path itself contains a .beads directory, use it.\n611\t/// Otherwise, assume the path IS the .beads directory.\n612\tfn get_beads_dir(workspace_path: &Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf> {\n613\t    let beads_dir = workspace_path.join(\".beads\");\n614\t    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n615\t        Ok(beads_dir)\n616\t    } else if workspace_path.ends_with(\".beads\") {\n617\t        Ok(workspace_path.to_path_buf())\n618\t    } else {\n619\t        use anyhow::bail;\n620\t        bail!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace_path)\n621\t    }\n622\t}\n623\t\n624\t/// Find all bead workspace directories starting from a search path.\n625\t///\n626\t/// Searches for directories containing a .beads subdirectory.\n627\t/// Searches upward from the start path through parent directories.\n628\tpub fn find_workspaces(start_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {\n629\t    let mut workspaces = Vec::new();\n630\t\n631\t    // Start from the given path and search upward\n632\t    let mut current = start_path.to_path_buf();\n633\t    loop {\n634\t        let beads_dir = current.join(\".beads\");\n635\t        if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n636\t            // Found a workspace - add the parent directory\n637\t            workspaces.push(current.clone());\n638\t        }\n639\t\n640\t        // Move to parent directory\n641\t        if !current.pop() {\n642\t            // Reached the root, stop searching\n643\t            break;\n644\t        }\n645\t    }\n646\t\n647\t    Ok(workspaces)\n648\t}\n649\t\n650\t#[cfg(test)]\n651\tmod tests {\n652\t    use super::*;\n653\t    use crate::model::{Issue, Status};\n654\t    use Arguments\n886\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n887\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n888\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n889\t    ///\n890\t    /// # Returns\n891\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n892\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n893\t        &self,\n894\t        root_id: &str,\n895\t        direction: &str,\n896\t        max_depth: usize,\n897\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n898\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n899\t\n900\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n901\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n902\t            \"up\" => {\n903\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n904\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n905\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n906\t                (\n907\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n908\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n909\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n910\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n911\t                )\n912\t            }\n913\t            _ => {\n914\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n915\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n916\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n917\t                (\n918\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n919\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n920\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n921\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n922\t                )\n923\t            }\n924\t        };\n925\t\n926\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n927\t            String::new()\n928\t        } else {\n929\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n930\t        };\n931\t\n932\t        let sql = format!(\n933\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n934\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n935\t                SELECT\n936\t                    {id_col} as id,\n937\t                    i.title,\n938\t                    i.status,\n939\t                    i.priority,\n940\t                    0 as depth,\n941\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n942\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n943\t                FROM dependencies d\n944\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n945\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n946\t\n947\t                UNION ALL\n948\t\n949\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n950\t                SELECT\n951\t                    {id_col} as id,\n952\t                    i.title,\n953\t                    i.status,\n954\t                    i.priority,\n955\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n956\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n957\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n958\t                FROM dependencies d\n959\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n960\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n961\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n962\t                {depth_limit}\n963\t            )\n964\t            SELECT id,      let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n971\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n972\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n973\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n974\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n975\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n976\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n977\t\n978\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n979\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n980\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n981\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n982\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n983\t                depth: row.get(4)?,\n984\t                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n985\t                path: if is_cycle {\n986\t                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n987\t                } else {\n988\t                    path\n989\t                },\n990\t            });\n991\t        }\n992\t        Ok(nodes)\n993\t    }\n994\t\n995\t    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n996\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n997\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n998\t    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n1340\t    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n1341\t    ///\n1342\t    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n1343\t    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n1344\t    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n1345\t    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n1346\t    ///\n1347\t    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n1348\t    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n1349\t    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n1350\t    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n1351\t        &self,\n1352\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1353\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1354\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1355\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1356\t\n1357\t        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n1358\t            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n1359\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1360\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1361\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n1362\t                        i.priority,\n1363\t                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n1364\t                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n1365\t                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n1366\t                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n1367\t                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n1368\t                 FROM issues i\n1369\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1370\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1371\t                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n1372\t                     AND vs.model = ?1\n1373\t                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n1374\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1375\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1376\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1377\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1378\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1379\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1380\t                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1381\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1382\t                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n1383\t                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1384\t                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n1385\t                   )\n1386\t                 GROUP BY i.id\n1387\t                 ORDER BY\n1388\t                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n1389\t                     downstream_impact DESC,\n1390\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1391\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1392\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1393\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1394\t            )?;\n1395\t\n1396\t            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n1397\t            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1398\t                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n1399\t                    row.get(0)?,\n1400\t                    row.get(1)?,\n1401\t                    row.get(2)?,\n1402\t                    row.get(3)?,\n1403\t                    row.get(4)?,\n1404\t                    row.get(5)?,\n1405\t                )))\n1406\t            } else {\n1407\t                Ok(None)\n1408\t            }\n1409\t        } else {\n1410\t            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n1411\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1412\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1413\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n1414\t                        i.priority,\n1415\t                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n1416\t                 FROM issues i\n1417\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1418\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1419\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1420\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1421\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1422\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1423\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1424\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1425\t                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1426\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1427\t                       WHERE critical_float ASC,\n1435\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1436\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1437\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1438\t            )?;\n1439\t\n1440\t            let              \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str, session_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time           params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn count_issues(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        let conn = an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub       events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    pub fn list_events_filtered(\n        &self,\n        issue_id: Option<&str>,\n        since: Option<&DateTime<Utc>>,\n        actor: Option<&str>,\n        event_type: Option<&EventType>,\n        limit: Option<usize>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n\n        if let Some(id) = issue_id {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND issue_id = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(dt) = since {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND created_at >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(a.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(et) = event_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND event_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(et.as_str().to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY created_at ASC\");\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", l));\n        }\n\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row:      params![issue_id],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn search_issues(\n        &self,\n        query: Option<&str>,\n        status: &[Status],\n        issue_type: &[IssueType],\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM in_progress: in_progress as usize,\n            closed: closed as usize,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_type(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>> {\n        let conn = cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n\n                // Compute combined_score for consistency\n                let combined_score = downstream_impact as f64 * 3.0\n                    + (4 - priority) as f64 * 2.0\n                    + 1000.0 / (critical_float as f64 + 1.0);\n\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    downstream_impact,\n                    critical_float,\n                    priority,\n                    created_at_ts,\n                    None, // No expected_seconds without velocity data\n                    combined_score,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker session for tracking metadata.\n    ///\n    /// Stores worker metadata (model, harness, version) for each
